newsitem.title: Malaysia: KL palm oil ends mixed, spot months firmer.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends mixed, spot months firmer.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
Mar (3rd pos) 1,272 rgt/tonne Jan (south) 1,325
Open/Hi/Low 1,274/1,277/1,267 Prev close 1,322.50
Prev settlement 1,271 * sellers prices

PALM OIL FUTURES - Spot and nearby months continued to surge due to a squeeze but prices generally closed mixed. Some profit-takings were seen in forwards. Market was uncertain after strong run-up. March futures hover between 1,267 and 1,277.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Continued firm with spot and nearby CPOs holding and interest was seen among selected products.

"Stocks are also considered low and this also helped sentiment partly," a trader in a local brokerage house said. Traders had estimated end-December stocks at around 810,000 to 820,000 tonnes and demand would be approximately 660,000 to 680,000 tonnes.
However, elsewhere, traders felt that the market has been overdone and some profit-takings were seen and some forward positions closed with small losses.
Trading was about uncertain in the afternoon with players having mixed views over the near-term trend, they said.

"The market should take a technical correction as prices are too high," another dealer added. "People are also unwilling to take huge commitments as they are concern over the outlook of next week official December crop data,"
Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) will release December stock/output/export data on January 15 to provide a trend for the market.
A crop forecaster, Ivan Wong said in his latest report that output was estimated to have fallen by 17.4 percent to 630,000 tonnes, end-December at 805,000 tonnes.
Turnover on the futures market was 2,090 lots.
Physical Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,325 against bids at 1,317.50 after trading from 1,320 and 1,325.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,325 and bids at 1,317.50.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,325 with bids at 1,315 with earlier trades of 1,322.50, and Feb (central) was offered at 1,320 and bids at 1,315.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $555 a FOB Malaysia and Feb/March at $552.50. Feb was traded at $552.50.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $587.50, Feb at $587.50 and March at $580. Feb was traded at $585 and Mar at $577.50.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $425, Feb at $425 and and Jan/Feb palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
Third month March futures closed one ringgit up at 1,272 ringgit ($511.87) a tonne.
